completion_gate: evaluate_completion requires every required Claim to have at least one current passed Evidence record and fails when Evidence is missing, stale, expired, revoked, contradicted, or when unresolved defects remain.
defect_generation: defect_from_result creates a DefectRecord only for failed or blocked gate results and preserves exact Claim, Gate, expected/actual, refs, and repair boundary.
compatibility: The existing task EvidenceGate implementation is not replaced; a regression test proves it still fails closed when an approve report has no evidence_refs.
